title: GUNFIRE ENDS SPRINT
why: His 10-28 decision says firing ends your sprint period, replacing the earlier 0.35 second pause. Watch in play: a quick shot while fleeing ends sprint; release and press Shift or LS again to run. Pad toggle also needs a fresh LS press. This newer order supersedes the 10-12 movement ruling.
now: A fired gunshot ends sprint until a fresh sprint press, in both windows and on keys or pad. Melee and a trigger that fires no round keep sprint.
